verses.text: Send the lamb to the ruler of the land, from Sela [in] the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

segments.text: Send the lamb to the ruler of the land, from Sela [in] the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

verses.text: And it will come to pass [that], like a fluttering bird [or] a nestling cast out, [so] shall be the daughters of Moab at the fords of the Arnon.

segments.text: And it will come to pass [that], like a fluttering bird [or] a nestling cast out, [so] shall be the daughters of Moab at the fords of the Arnon.

verses.text: “Bring in counsel; make judgment; set like the night your shadow in the middle of noontime. Hide those driven away, do not uncover the one fleeing.

segments.text: “Bring in counsel; make judgment; set like the night your shadow in the middle of noontime. Hide those driven away, do not uncover the one fleeing.

verses.text: Let sojourn among you the outcasts of Moab; be a shelter for them from the face of the destroyer.” For the extortioner comes to an end and destruction ceases; the tramplers of the land are finished off.

segments.text: Let sojourn among you the outcasts of Moab; be a shelter for them from the face of the destroyer.” For the extortioner comes to an end and destruction ceases; the tramplers of the land are finished off.

verses.text: And in loving devotion a throne will be established, and one will sit on it in faithfulness in the tent of David—one judging and seeking justice, and hastening righteousness.

verses.text: We have heard of the pride of Moab—exceeding pride—of his arrogance and his pride and his wrath; not so [are] his lies.

segments.text: We have heard of the pride of Moab—exceeding pride—of his arrogance and his pride and his wrath; not so [are] his lies.

verses.text: Therefore Moab will wail; let everyone wail for Moab; for the raisin-cakes of Kir-Hareseth you⁺ will mourn, utterly stricken.

segments.text: Therefore Moab will wail; let everyone wail for Moab; for the raisin-cakes of Kir-Hareseth you⁺ will mourn, utterly stricken.

verses.text: For the fields of Heshbon languish, [and] the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have struck down its choicest vines, [which] had reached as far as Jazer, and wandered [to] the desert—her branches stretched out [and] passed over the sea.

verses.text: Upon thus I weep with the weeping of Jazer, for the vine of Sibmah, I will drench you [with] my tears, O Heshbon and Elealeh. For over your summer fruit—over your summer fruit the shouting have fallen silent.

verses.text: And gladness and rejoicing are gathered up from the field of planting, and in the vineyards there is no singing, and no shouting, [and] the wine in the presses, the treader does not tread; their shouting I have made cease.

verses.text: Upon thus my bowels do moan for Moab like a harp, and my inmost being for Kir-heres.

verses.text: And it will come to pass, when it is seen that Moab has become weary on the high place, that he will come to his sanctuary to pray; he will not prevail.

verses.text: This [is] the word that YHWH has spoken to Moab from that time;

segments.text: This [is] the word that YHWH has spoken to Moab from that time;

verses.text: and YHWH has spoken, saying, “In three years, according to the years of a hireling, then the glory of Moab will be turned to dishonor, with all the great multitude; and the remnant [is] little—small, not mighty.”
